prompt: On https://books.toscrape.com open each of these categories in turn using the links on the site: Travel, Mystery, Historical Fiction, Sequential Art, Classics, Philosophy, Romance, Womens Fiction. Take a snapshot of each category page and note the price of the first book listed. What is the sum of those eight prices, in pounds?
On https://quotes.toscrape.com go through pages 1 to 10 in order, taking a snapshot of each page. How many quotes in total on those ten pages are by Albert Einstein?

Using the Rust standard library docs at doc.rust-lang.org, open each of these pages and take a snapshot: std/vec/struct.Vec.html, std/string/struct.String.html, std/collections/struct.HashMap.html, std/option/enum.Option.html, std/result/enum.Result.html. Report the Rust version in which each of these methods became stable, as the page shows it: Vec::extract_if, String::retain, HashMap::retain, Option::zip, Result::inspect. Give all five on one line.

Open each of these English Wikipedia articles and take a snapshot: Go (programming language), Python (programming language), C (programming language), Java (programming language), Ruby (programming language), Perl. From each article's infobox, read the year the language first appeared. What is the sum of the six years?

Open https://demo.playwright.dev/todomvc. Add these todos one at a time, taking a snapshot after each: milk, eggs, bread, tea, rice, salt, soap, oil. Then mark eggs, tea and salt as completed, taking a snapshot after each. What number does the items-left counter show?
notes: one page, many repeat snapshots (diffs), about 25 turns
